title: [3.0.0.1] Buttons disappear when pump is disconnected
body:
Since 3.0.0.1 it's not possible to access Insulin Dialog and BolusWizard when the pump is disconnected.

This leads to the following problems:

- it is not possible to tell if a bolus should be given when the pump is disconnected from the body (eg. when swimming)
- "Do no bolus, record only" checkbox is more or less useless now
(because the pump must be reconnected to enter that insulin -> SMB kick in at the moment of reconnection, before even having the chance to enter already injected insulin.)

Since this is a major drawback compared to previous versions, my proposal would be reverting to the old behavior and if necessary, disable the "OK" buttons in BolusWizard and InsulinDialog when disconnected.
